definitions.explanation: A shop where one gets a haircut, especially a traditional barbershop catering mainly to men. Can also refer to the barber who works there. A casual, everyday word.

examples.japanese: {散髪屋|さんぱつや}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧。
⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{散髪屋|さんぱつや}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{髪|かみ}→髪：02196_kami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{切|き}った→切る：02693_kiru⟧。
examples.english: I got my hair cut at the barbershop in front of the station.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}ども⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{頃|ころ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{連|つ}れられて→連れる：01240_tsureru⟧⟦{近所|きんじょ}→近所：01318_kinjo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{散髪屋|さんぱつや}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{通|かよ}っていた→通う：01217_kayou⟧。
examples.english: When I was a child, my father would take me to the neighborhood barbershop.

notes:
Combines ⟦{散髪|さんぱつ}→散髪：06318_sanpatsu⟧ (haircut) + ⟦{屋|や}→〜屋：03096_ya⟧ (shop, store). A casual word for a barbershop, especially the traditional kind for men. The suffix ⟦{屋|や}→〜屋：03096_ya⟧ names a shop by what it sells or does.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {散髪屋|さんぱつや}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧: to go to the barbershop
- {散髪屋|さんぱつや}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{髪|かみ}→髪：02196_kami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧: to get a haircut at the barbershop

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{理髪店|りはつてん}→理髪店：06320_rihatsuten⟧: barbershop — the more formal, signboard term
- ⟦{床屋|とこや}→床屋：01682_tokoya⟧: barbershop — another common colloquial word, much like {散髪屋|さんぱつや}
- ⟦{美容院|びよういん}→美容院：06319_biyouin⟧: beauty salon — offers cutting and styling for all genders
